mapper.select: SELECT POPUP_NUM, TITLE, CONTENT, START_AT, END_AT, USE_YN, TARGET_ALL, CONTENT_VER, CREATED_AT FROM POPUP_NOTICE ORDER BY POPUP_NUM DESC
SELECT CLI_CODE FROM POPUP_NOTICE_TARGET WHERE POPUP_NUM = #{popupNum} ORDER BY CLI_CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POPUP_NOTICE (TITLE, CONTENT, START_AT, END_AT, USE_YN, TARGET_ALL) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{useYn}, #{targetAll})
mapper.update: UPDATE POPUP_NOTICE SET CONTENT_VER = CONTENT_VER + IF(BINARY TITLE <> BINARY #{title} OR BINARY CONTENT <> BINARY #{content}, 1, 0), TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, START_AT = #{startAt}, END_AT = #{endAt}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, TARGET_ALL = #{targetAll} WHERE POPUP_NUM = #{popupNum}
UPDATE POPUP_NOTICE SET USE_YN = #{useYn} WHERE POPUP_NUM = #{popupNum}
mapper.select: SELECT p.POPUP_NUM AS popupNum, p.TITLE AS title, p.CONTENT AS content, p.CONTENT_VER AS contentVer FROM POPUP_NOTICE p WHERE p.USE_YN = 'Y' AND #{now} >= p.START_AT AND #{now} <= p.END_AT AND (p.TARGET_ALL = 'Y' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM POPUP_NOTICE_TARGET t WHERE t.POPUP_NUM = p.POPUP_NUM AND t.CLI_CODE = #{cliCode})) ORDER BY p.POPUP_NUM DESC LIMIT 1
